Identity continuity: Brinis Ulena, age 36, gender presentation man, skin-value band 3; soft rectangular face; deep-set eyes and a heavy level brow; flat broad nose, defined cupid's bow; no added facial mark Preserve adult age cues, face geometry, skin, and expression; use a calm closed mouth with no smile or theatrical acting. findings.observation: The adult remains recognizably Brinis: the same band-3 mature masculine identity, soft rectangular face, deep-set eyes, heavy level brow, flat broad nose, defined cupid’s bow, closed neutral mouth, and unmarked skin remain legible without a baby or generic doll-face read.

The accepted summon’s very-tall conditioned silhouette is not preserved strongly enough. The chibi broadens the torso and hips, thickens the legs, and reads compact-stocky rather than tall, upright, functionally toned, and non-bulky.

Both arms and empty hands are coherent and anatomically complete, but the forearms, wrists, and fists are visibly enlarged and thickened relative to the source’s long conditioned limbs, creating generic chibi limb inflation.
The blonde-gold bob/pageboy retains the source’s rounded front and side silhouette, central construction, carefully perfected grooming, and sharply segmented stepped fringe.

The teal-brown asymmetric repaired patchwork, broad folded collar, small palette repeats, uneven divided hems, practical trousers, leg wraps, and shoes remain source-faithful, with no tattoo or invented accessory. However, the summon’s distinctive wooden comb is absent rather than retained visibly in a tucked, non-handheld form compatible with the required two empty hands, weakening the requested personal-object continuity.

Original-resolution measurement places the complete hair-to-chin unit at about 31% of standing height, approximately 3.2 heads tall. This is just below the locked 32–36% share and outside the required 2.75–3.1-head range.
Exactly one coherent full-body subject appears; the complete hair, head, both empty hands, all garment edges, both feet, and grounding shadow remain inside generous safe margins.
The planted staggered stance, separated empty fists, forward shoulders, and clear silhouette read immediately as a grounded weaponless ready-idle at combat-icon scale.

The character remains ordinary repaired cloth and worn practical shoes with no weapon, armor upgrade, magic, aura, glow, affinity cue, gem, floating, frame, star, number, UI, text, logo, watermark, or supernatural effect.
